abstract: Maintains environmental climate stability and microclimate purge verification
system_message:
You are Head of preventive conservation (CONS). The Head of preventive conservation (CONS) manages environmental climate stability, atmospheric microclimate controls, and optical radiation monitoring across emergency cultural asset relocation repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Optical radiation monitoring（UVFL）
information_points.content:
CONS-UVFL-JU0：Photometric audit surveys at Highland Redoubt Storage Complex record an ambient UV exposure flux of 10 uW/lm within staging vestibules.
CONS-UVFL-DII：The recorded ambient UV exposure flux within the staging vestibules of Oakhaven Deep Archive Facility is 40 uW/lm.
CONS-UVFL-VA4：Photometric audit surveys for Blackwood Subterranean Vault show an ambient UV exposure flux of 25 uW/lm in the staging vestibules.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental climate stability and microclimate purge verification（CLIM）
information_points.content:
CONS-CLIM-864：For Blackwood Subterranean Vault, active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability is confirmed to be operational, and the maximum relative humidity variance across main storage chambers during the 30-day baseline test is 4 %.
CONS-CLIM-83P：At Oakhaven Deep Archive Facility, active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability is present and verified operational, while the maximum relative humidity variance evaluated over the 30-day baseline test is 2 %.
CONS-CLIM-TQ9：Highland Redoubt Storage Complex maintains operational active atmospheric nitrogen purge capability in its primary storage vaults, with a maximum relative humidity variance of 8 % recorded over the 30-day baseline test.
